label: nyiso 140 layup exclusion
definition: NYISO KEEPER (promoted 2026-08-16, nyiso-140). Excludes the economically laid-up Port Jefferson (2517) from the always-on Long_Island ST_GAS reliability floor — a rule-17 [R-FLOOR-WINDOW] MEMBERSHIP correction, never a window change. The limb is IDENTIFIED on a fleet-aggregate when-available capacity factor but APPLIED per UNIT (pro_rata), and 2517's own CAMPD conduct is median CF EXACTLY 0.000 in every hour block of 2023/2024/2025 with 73 % of cool hours at zero, while carrying ~100 % model availability because the 2026-07-26 guard fix correctly un-booked lay-up from the outage extract. It absorbed 72.6 % of everything the limb forced (1.87 of 2.57 TWh over 3 yr) on 7.2 % of the fleet's output. The 24-hour WINDOW is confirmed CORRECT and is UNCHANGED — Barrett (2511) and Northport (2516) genuinely run the persistent cable-islanded baseline (cool-day median CF 0.254/0.313 at h00-05). floor_pct is UNCHANGED at 0.262: the two CANCELLING basis errors (a daily-mean statistic applied hourly; a fleet aggregate applied per unit) correct to 0.2666, so ZERO free parameters are added (rule 21 [R-DOF], n_residual unchanged at 6). CALIBRATED (rubric v3.3, owner amendment 2026-08-17: a ledgered C3c caveat is REPORTED at full magnitude but no longer DOWNGRADES the determination; before the amendment this run read the with-caveats determination, and no criterion moved), C3c the lone ledgered caveat — identical to the superseded keeper; C1/C2/C3a/C3b/C4/C6/C8 all PASS. It is the keeper on rule 1 [R-STRUCT] and the owner's standing structure-over-gates clause — the floor was forcing a laid-up plant, which is wrong whatever it does to the residual — and NO gated criterion regresses. Under rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] the degradation is a DISCOVERED BUG: the manufactured 1.87 TWh was masking a real downstate under-production (2025 ST_GAS already -21 % before the fix), and the successor is that root cause, never re-flooring the laid-up plant. First application of the owner-adopted K6' gate (2026-08-16): the surviving nyiso_gas_commitment_bridge share ROSE while doing strictly less work, which bare K6 would have killed. STANDING CAVEAT: K6' leg (a) leans on D-4, which is TAUTOLOGICAL for an h0-23 floor (offwindow_share 0.0 by construction), and the adopted D-4 per-unit rider is NOT yet implemented — that leg is unproven rather than passed.
